style: Places, no people. Unretouched 35mm documentary photograph, natural colour as shot on Kodak Portra 400/800, honest exposure, natural grain, no heavy colour grade. Photographed through wet glass: droplets and rivulets in the near foreground, slightly soft, refracting the scene.
negative: purple, violet, magenta, neon glow, oversaturated, plastic skin, illustration, 3d render, text, watermark, frame border
